name: Split
action: Separate original source, individual continuous resolvents and their positive composition.

name: Falsify
action: Search complex source zeros; one validated interior witness kills a full-strip logarithm for that host and kernel.

name: Reverse
action: Apply (alpha^2-D^2)Psi=2alphaPhi as control, preserving all derivative and tail terms.

name: Viewpoint
action: Keep spectral zeros but change the positive source representation; distinguish arithmetic function from source coordinates.

name: Visual
action: Save root map for12 host/kernel combinations; compare with discrete-tail witnesses.

name: Action
action: Apply Laplace kernels atalpha=.5,1.5 and their composition to each of4 arithmetic hosts.

name: Essentials
action: Retain full theta source, total exponential moment, both upper incomplete-gamma tails and all partial-fraction terms.

name: Similar
action: Use zeta, primitive conductor4/5 and actual Davenport-Heilbronn as separately verified hosts.

name: Small
action: Single resolvent is minimal; original differential identity is control, not discovery.

name: Extreme
action: Composition removes two spectral pole pairs from reciprocal multiplier; inspect near source-strip boundary and both real tails by symmetry.

name: Experiment
action: 60digit pilot/control gates and12cases,14workers maximum,one600second cap. Selected surprises require100/160independent ODE/Jacobi validation.

name: Invariant
action: Fourier multipliers2alpha/(alpha^2+w^2) have no zeros or interior RH-strip poles; convolution preserves real positivity/evenness.

name: Monotone
action: Do not assume smoother source has fewer complex zeros or composition improves the logarithm domain.

name: Weaker bridge
action: Finite interior node witnesses only; no root found cannot certify nonvanishing.

name: Stronger hunch
action: Continuous kernel might remove discrete Floquet obstruction; test whether a different complex-source obstruction remains.

name: Minimal counterexample
action: Compare composition against both constituent resolvents for same host.

name: Representation
action: Compute via upper incomplete-gamma tails; validate with forced ODE and independent Jacobi source.

name: Technique
action: Current deep/source-method hits support convolution and Gaussian heat primitives but not this complete bridge. Homogenization paper suggests testing microscopic structure versus limiting representation.

name: Fake proof
action: Same spectral zeros and positive source do not entail RH or holomorphic source logarithm.

name: Missing lemma
action: Global nonvanishing of an admissible source representation and a source-specific real-rootedness theorem; either may fail.

name: Dependency
action: Verified arithmetic host -> convergent Green convolution -> exact spectral multiplier -> numerical source nodes; no HB action attachment.

name: Nearby false
action: Gaussian-source convolution is exactly a rotated/rescaled backward deBruijn deformation; naive scanning was rejected as a repackaging.

name: Boundary
action: Retain multiplier poles at+-i alpha and noncompact source tails; source evaluation confined to |Im z|<pi/4.

name: Salvage
action: If all tested Green sources retain nodes, abandon generic resolvent removal and identify representation-invariant information required of a source-to-spectrum mechanism.
